name: codex-binder-lane
description: Design protein binders for a chosen target site, compare approved tools and costs, and organize sequences, structures, scores, and images.

interface.longDescription: Design protein binders for a specific target site while staying within your budget. Binder Lane coordinates the scientific tools you approve, checks each stage, and organizes candidate sequences, predicted structures, scores, and images. It asks before starting paid work or sharing private data.
defaultPrompt: Design protein binders for this target and binding site. Compare available tools and costs before starting paid work.
Review these protein binder candidates. Check their sequences, structures, and scores, then flag weak or missing evidence.
Create a final report with each binder's sequence, predicted structure, binding-site results, images, costs, and open questions.
